chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail al-Razi, from Suleiman ibn Ja'far al-Ja'fari, who said:

I entered upon Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), and in front of him were Barni dates, and he was diligent in eating them, eating them with desire. So he said to me: 'O Suleiman, approach and eat.' He said: So I approached him and ate with him, and I said to him: 'May I be sacrificed for you, I see you eating this date with desire.' So he said: 'Yes, I indeed love it.'

He said: I said, 'And why is that?' He said: 'Because the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was a date-lover, and Ali (peace be upon him) was a date-lover, and al-Hasan (peace be upon him) was a date-lover, and Abu Abdillah al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was a date-lover, and Zayn al-Abideen (peace be upon him) was a date-lover, and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) was a date-lover, and Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was a date-lover, and my father (peace be upon him) was a date-lover, and I am a date-lover. And our Shias love dates because they were created from our clay. And our enemies, O Suleiman, love the intoxicants because they were created from a smokeless fire.'

key_terms.تَمْرٌ بَرْنِيٌّ: Barni dates, a specific variety of dates
key_terms.طِينَتِنَا: Our clay, referring to the spiritual lineage/origin
key_terms.مَارِجٌ مِنْ نَارٍ: Smokeless fire, referring to the creation of Jinn/enemies

ai.seo_question: Why do the Shia love dates according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the theological concept of 'tamyiz' (discernment) through physical preferences, linking the Ahl al-Bayt's love for dates to their creation from pure clay. It contrasts the Shia, who inherit this spiritual lineage, with their enemies who love intoxicants, reflecting the Quranic description of jinn created from 'smokeless fire.' This establishes a metaphysical basis for the distinct identity and habits of the Shia community.
